title: System Update
subtitle: Keep your Project NOMAD instance up to date with the latest features and improvements.

alerts.container_restarting_msg: The admin container is restarting. This page will reload automatically when the update is complete.
alerts.connection_lost_msg: You may see error notifications while the backend restarts during the update. This is completely normal and expected. Connection should be restored momentarily.
alerts.backup_reminder_msg: While updates are designed to be safe, it's always recommended to backup any critical data before proceeding.
alerts.downtime_msg: Services will be briefly unavailable during the update process. This typically takes 2-5 minutes depending on your internet connection.

status.new_version_available: A new version ({{version}}) is available for your Project NOMAD instance.
status.running_latest: Your system is running the latest version!

what_happens.title: What happens during an update?
what_happens.step_1_desc: Downloads the newest Docker images for all core containers
what_happens.step_2_desc: Safely stops and recreates all core containers with the new images
what_happens.step_3_desc: This page will automatically reload when the update is complete

early_access.title: Early Access
early_access.description: Receive release candidate (RC) versions before they are officially released. Note: RC versions may contain bugs and are not recommended for environments where stability and data integrity are critical.

newsletter.title: Want to stay updated with the latest from Project NOMAD? Subscribe to receive release notes directly to your inbox. Unsubscribe anytime.
newsletter.privacy_note: We care about your privacy. Project NOMAD will never share your email with third parties or send you spam.

core.title: Automatic Core Updates
core.disabled_default: Automatic core updates were disabled after repeated failures.
core.enable_desc: Automatically install minor and patch updates during your chosen window. Major versions always require a manual update due to their potentially breaking nature.
core.cooloff_help: Delay after a release is published
core.status_none: No eligible update — system is current or the latest release is a major version / still in cool-off.

app.title: Automatic App Updates
app.enable_desc: Automatically install minor and patch updates for apps you've opted in (toggle each app in Supply Depot). Major versions always require a manual update. Uses the same update window and cool-off period as the core schedule above.
app.toggle_error: Failed to update app auto-update setting.
app.no_apps: No apps are opted in yet. Enable auto-update on individual apps from the Supply Depot.

content.title: Automatic Content Updates
content.disabled_default: Automatic content updates were disabled after repeated failures.
content.enable_desc: Automatically download newer versions of your installed Information Library content (ZIM files) and maps during your chosen window. Content downloads can be very large, so set a per-window data cap to limit how much is pulled at once. We recommend allowing at least 0.5 GB per update window to ensure most updates can be pulled in a timely manner, but you can set a lower cap if you have very limited bandwidth and don't mind some updates being skipped (they will still appear in the UI and can be updated manually). If an update repeatedly fails to download within the window, it will be automatically disabled and require manual intervention to re-enable.
content.cooloff_help: Delay after a new version appears
content.data_cap_error: Data cap must be 0 or a positive number of GB.
content.save_error: Failed to save content update schedule.
content.toggle_error: Failed to update content auto-update setting.
content.all_up_to_date: All installed content is up to date. New versions will appear here when detected.
content.exceeds_cap: Skipped — exceeds data cap, update manually

manual.title: Manual Content Updates
manual.desc: Check if newer versions of your installed ZIM files and maps are available.
manual.all_up_to_date_msg: All your installed content is running the latest available version.
manual.check_failed: Failed to check for content updates
